authorization: User agreed to continue the revised measurement-interface experiment while retaining the communication research direction.
design: 12 fresh reliability-pair cells x 2 label complements x 2 origin relations x (3 shared initial calls + 2 rule levels x 2 field-order instructions x 2 peer conditions) = 528 calls. Independent sample size is 12, not 528.
rule_levels: unspecified decision rule, original probability definition
explicit symmetric MAP decision, exact tie assigned to 0
peer_levels: actual B/C initial answer fields only
initials: A/B/C each receive one observation, a correct task-specific calculator and the explicit decision rule. The same actual outputs are shared across all eight final arms. Invalid initials are marked unavailable, never repaired or resampled.
matching: Same visible evidence, origin map, correct calculator and own actual initial assessment across all final arms. Rule and order vary only their instruction suffixes. Natural condition adds only actual B/C answer artifacts. Seeds matched across final arms; seeded randomized call order.
primary: Within no-peer arms, explicit-minus-unspecified and probability-first-minus-answer-first effects on posterior MAE and MAP consistency, separately by origin relation. Average complements and the other factor within each cell; complete means require all 12 cells. Eight descriptive contrasts, no significance claims.
secondary: Natural-minus-no-peer posterior MAE and oracle-MAP direction in the fixed explicit/probability-first arm; format validity, observed field-order compliance, per-arm counts and actual resources. Order noncompliance retained in intention-to-treat analysis. No manipulation-compliant subset selection.
gate: Fixed explicit/probability-first/no-peer arm: all 48 outputs valid, at least 95% posterior correct at 1e-4 and at least 95% consistent decisions; all 144 initials valid. If gate fails or a primary contrast is incomplete, discuss before more inference. Gate is engineering readiness, not significance or publication acceptance.
limitations: One model and synthetic conditional evidence grid
Structured calculator output in user JSON, not native tool-calling
No sampled truth label, therefore direction means oracle-MAP direction, not empirical label accuracy
No-peer exact-repeat control absent in this factorial; prior repeats are not pooled
Field-order instruction may not control latent computation order
Answer consistency in unspecified arm is a scoring convention, not explicit instruction compliance
Interface improvement is not novelty or delayed-release benefit
No adaptive sample extension, retries, output correction or favorable-only filtering

literature_context.boundary: Evidence-response-confidence misalignment is prior art; natural QA evidence studies are not the same as fixed-event synthetic probability tasks.
Selected-answer confidence differs from P(Y=1). Do not enforce answer dependence on a fixed-event probability or claim generic inconsistency as novel.
